basis: Supplied LICENSES.md plus manual upstream checks recorded in docs/DATA_SOURCES.md. Offline audit verifies pack declarations; it does not refresh web licenses.

datasets.declared_license: City of Mississauga open data terms
datasets.attribution: Contains information provided by the City of Mississauga. 2021 census; pack-derived corrected Ward 10.
datasets.upstream_review: Current dataset-specific terms not conclusively matched; older city-hosted terms contain inconsistent city naming.
datasets.redistribution: Local analysis; retain attribution. Review applicable dataset terms before public export.
datasets.scope: Corrected ward/census metadata; raw 311 is excluded from MVP.

datasets.attribution: Google; Conneau et al. (2022), FLEURS: Few-shot Learning Evaluation of Universal Representations of Speech.
datasets.redistribution: Attributed, curated clips only after selection/review; include source, license link and modification notice. No clips approved by this audit.
datasets.scope: MVP speech source; supplied pack omits Bengali.

datasets.attribution: Weinberger, S. (2015), Speech Accent Archive, George Mason University; https://osf.io/yh23d.
datasets.upstream_review: Pack declaration verified; upstream license not independently retrieved.
datasets.redistribution: Excluded from public MVP audio. Noncommercial and ShareAlike restrictions; resolve upstream terms before reuse.
datasets.scope: Stretch only; do not export age, birthplace or other speaker details.

datasets.attribution: PolyAI; Gerz et al. (2021), Multilingual and Cross-Lingual Intent Detection from Spoken Data.
datasets.redistribution: Coverage counts only in MVP; attributed clips require a separate deliberate review.
datasets.scope: Banking request metadata; locale labels are not a guarantee of actual spoken language.

datasets.attribution: FBK; Lee et al. (2024), Speech-MASSIVE: A Multilingual Speech Dataset for SLU and Beyond.
datasets.upstream_review: FBK project page and dataset listing corroborate CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
datasets.redistribution: No public MVP audio/transcripts; noncommercial and ShareAlike restrictions apply to reuse as stated in pack.
datasets.scope: Coverage counts only; no speaker background exported.

datasets.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence - Toronto.
datasets.redistribution: Raw 311 is excluded; any later reuse requires attribution and applicable licence conditions.
datasets.scope: Toronto context only; never join Toronto ward IDs to Mississauga.
